# Code of conduct

Bitty Buddies is a friendly project for people of all ages. Wherever you talk to us (GitHub issues, our Discord, comments on our posts), please:

- **Be kind.** Treat everyone with respect, whatever their background, age, skill level or opinions.
- **Keep it family-friendly.** No hate, harassment, bullying, sexual content, slurs or threats.
- **Stay on topic.** Help, ideas, bugs and fan love are all welcome. Spam and self-promotion aren't.
- **Respect privacy.** Don't share anyone's personal details, and don't ask for them.
- **Play fair.** Don't share, sell or crack licence keys, and don't re-upload the app or its art.

## If something goes wrong

Tell a moderator on our [Discord](https://discord.gg/aCHyjABJG7), or use GitHub's **Report content** option on the comment or issue. Reports are handled privately.

Moderators can edit or remove posts, and warn, mute or ban people who break these rules, on GitHub and on Discord.
